comment: How the AI advisors decide (GDD 8.1-8.4, 7.6; stages 4a-4b). Every advisor scores its possible actions the same way: a base value times factors from response curves, times the strategist's goal weight and the character multiplier (0.5 + trait), minus the cost. pickAmongTop: how many of the best actions the AI draws among, chances by score (GDD 8.3); a civilization takes the best one outright with a chance equal to its caution. Strategist (every reviewEverySteps own steps of the civilization (ADR 0018), spread over civilizations, and at once in a new era): expansion weight from how full the camps are (up to crowdingLowPercent: expansionWeightMin, at crowdingHighPercent: expansionWeightMax); prosperity and security weight from hunger (fedWellPercent -> 1.0, fedBadlyPercent -> hungerWeightMax); an expansion target on the best known free land, which boosts places closer to it by directionBonusPercent. An expansive civilization splits camps earlier, but never below splitMinPercentOfLevel. Settlers (a crowded camp's group, a village's settlers) leave only while the civilization's administration uses less than settlersBelowAdminPercent of what its government manages; a hungry village still sends mouths away (stage 6 PR T2, decision of 2026-11-14; stability.json, population.json levelLimitScatters). Artisans switch recipes only when the new one is better by recipeSwitchBetterByPercent. A hungry or cold camp looks for a better place every searchEverySteps own steps (staggered), every own step when fed below starvingFedPercent or on planets with live seasons. Values (PR B, 2026-11-06): every option serves a goal and is scored priority x cost factor. Food serves goalOfFood, every other good goalOfGoods. Scholar: a technology is worth what it gives this civilization per year (barter units): baseWorthPerPerson for any technology (science), fieldWorthPerPerson for the science/society/military field (science, influence, conquest), the yields of its gathering bonuses on the zone's cells (gatherWorthPercent; the goal of the good), its recipes (value added per year of the civilization's artisans; missingInputPercent while an input is neither held nor gathered), villageWorthPerPerson when it opens villages (security), effects by stat (perHundredPeoplePerPoint; cold tolerance only for the degrees the coldest camp lacks), and leadsToPercent of the best technology it opens the way to; each part times its goal weight and character. Cost factor = r x (r + (1 - r) x curiosity x curiosityCostReliefPercent), r = cheapest cost / this cost: without curiosity r squared. Treasurer: outputs minus inputs at internal prices (an input priced without the deciding settlement's own recipe demand), each good times its goal weight and character; valuables get tradeGoodsBonusPercent x tradefulness while goods flow to a trade partner. Strategist: science weight rises to scienceWeightMax when the best civilization met knows scienceBehindTechs technologies more; influence weight rises to influenceWeightMax with influenceMetCivs civilizations met. Governor: a move gets moveExpansionSharePercent of the expansion weight and expansiveness over staying; journeys must be journeyBetterByPercent better and lose journeyPenaltyPerMillePerCell per cell; far places on a lattice of farSearchEveryCells; the strategist's target loses all value at targetZeroAtJourneys journeys; settling needs settleFarmYieldPercent; plunder only below plunderBelowStoragePercent of storage; a village fed below villageHungryFedPercent sends settlers (at most once in villageHungrySettlersEveryYears, staggered): the group takes the share of mouths the village cannot feed, at most half of it, at least villageSettlersPeople (AI fixes after stage 4g); uncomfortableBelowPercent comfort starts a search; full sympathy or hatred moves the wish to drive out a camp by opinionSwingPercent. State (stage 4f PR 5): an overloaded state (administration over its government's capacity) multiplies the expansion weight by capacity / used, at least overloadExpansionMinPercent; in unrest (stability below stability.json unrestBelow) the security weight is multiplied by unrestSecurityPercent and the diplomat's war scores by unrestWarPercent. In each review the strategist weighs the governments open in its era: suitability = sum of trait x leaning (the character with the leader's traits) plus, in unrest, governmentStabilityWeight per point of the government's stability bonus; it brings in the best one only when it suits governmentChangeMarginPercent percent better than the present one, and never within governmentKeepYears of the last change of government (a coup counts). Diplomat: planned reviews are reviewStaggerYears apart between civilizations. Foreign camps and warriors count only on cells seen in the civilization's last own step. A player's order holds (stage 6 PR P1, Patryk 2026-11-13): the AI does not move, split, join or raid from a settlement for playerOrderHoldYears years of action after a player gave it an order (or after the player's settlers founded it), nor while a work group the player sent from it is out; it does not recall a campaign the player directed or make peace with its enemy until it ends. Since stage 6 PR 2 (decision of 2026-11-09) durations of war, diplomacy and politics are years of action: one year = 12 months of action = 60 ticks = 6 s at x1 (time.json).

commander.comment: The commander (stage 4e PR 5, GDD 8.1, decisions of 2026-11-07). It plays the battle through in its head from what it sees: the defenders of a target in sight with their arms and the terrain of the cell it would attack from, its own army with arms and morale; 25 battles with steady luck from the worst to the best of battle.rollPercent (war.json), no drawing. It sends an army only when it wins at least minWinChancePercent of them and expects to lose at most maxLossPercent of its warriors (a target out of sight: the warriors go to look). Road and food: the march beyond the reach of carriers (supply.carrierCells from the nearest own settlement) there and back must leave at least minFoodMonths months of food. Every month of a campaign it looks again (an army sees war.json armySightCells around it): it turns back when the expected chance falls below recallChancePercent, or when the food left will not bring the army back within the carriers' reach.
